findings.title: Partition lock map accessed without synchronization
findings.body: OffsetTracker._get_partition_lock does dict get then setdefault on self.partition_locks with no global lock. Concurrent add_offset/complete_offset/get_committable_offsets from submitter, N workers, and commit thread can race creating locks for the same new Partition, creating two different Locks and mutating the dict concurrently. Consequence is lost mutual exclusion for a partition, corrupting all_offsets/outstanding sets and causing wrong committable offsets, stalls, or duplicate/lost commits.

findings.title: Shutdown flag prevents draining queued work
findings.body: FixedQueuePool.shutdown sets worker.shutdown=True before calling q.shutdown(immediate=False), and OrderedQueueWorker.run loops on while not self.shutdown. Workers that have not yet entered get() will exit immediately and leave already-queued WorkItems unprocessed, with offsets never completed. SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy.close/terminate/join call this on rebalance/shutdown. Consequence is silent data loss for buffered results and offsets that never become committable.

findings.title: Offsets committed from background thread
findings.body: SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy spawns a commit_thread that calls the Arroyo Commit object every second via commit_function, outside poll/submit/join. Arroyo Commit/StreamProcessor commit paths are not designed for concurrent calls from user threads and interact with rebalance/close lifecycle. Consequence is races with partition revocation, commits after revoke, duplicate commits, or crashes, plus leaked commit threads when strategies are recreated.

findings.title: Single shared queue pool reused across rebalances
findings.body: ResultsStrategyFactory creates one FixedQueuePool in __init__ and every create_with_partitions returns a new SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy sharing that pool and its OffsetTracker, each with its own commit thread. On rebalance Arroyo closes the old strategy, whose close() shuts down the shared pool out from under the new strategy, and old commit threads are never stopped. Consequence is workers killed after rebalance, stuck processing, double commits, and assert failures once shutdown() sets queue_pool to None.

findings.title: wait_until_empty ignores in-flight items
findings.body: FixedQueuePool.wait_until_empty and get_stats use only Queue.qsize(), which drops to zero as soon as a worker dequeues an item, before result_processor finishes and before OffsetTracker.complete_offset runs. Callers polling for total_items==0 can conclude work is done while items are still processing. Consequence is premature test assertions and, if reused for shutdown/commit gating, committing or shutting down too early.

findings.title: Filtered/decode failures handled via assert/exception path
findings.body: SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy.submit decodes then asserts isinstance(message.value, BrokerValue), while decoder decode_payload asserts payload is not FilteredPayload. A FilteredPayload therefore triggers an AssertionError caught by the generic except that logs Error submitting message to queue and then marks the offset complete. Consequence is noisy exception logs for normal filtered messages and, for any non-BrokerValue message, the offset is never tracked at all, permanently blocking contiguous commit for that partition.
